descrizione: A giant toy water cannon blaster from the 1990s: chunky glossy plastic in turquoise, yellow and orange, a fat barrel ending in a wide flared orange nozzle with four radial fins, a round pressure gauge dial with a needle on top, a big yellow pump grip under the barrel, an orange trigger handle, a short stub of turquoise corrugated hose at the back. Oversized and powerful, 70 cm long.
